name: Button
description: Triggers an action. The one solid primary Button marks the main action of a view.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the spinner over the label and keeps the button's width. Pointer clicks are ignored while loading.
props.a11y: Sets aria-busy and keeps the label for screen readers.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. With href, renders an anchor without href and with aria-disabled.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor with the same styles.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the label, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon name after the label, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: type
props.description: The native button type. Ignored when href renders an anchor.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { root: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native button, or an anchor when href is set.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The button text. Stays in the accessibility tree while loading.

parts.name: spinner
parts.description: Loading indicator, centered over the label while loading.

requirements: Uses a native button element, or an anchor when href is set.
xs buttons extend their hit area to --apui-target-size-min (24px).
Loading keeps the label for screen readers and sets aria-busy.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
